I am a PhD candidate in mathematics at the [University of Stuttgart](https://www.uni-stuttgart.de/), supervised by [Marco Oesting](https://www.isa.uni-stuttgart.de/institut/team/Oesting/).

My research lies at the intersection of extreme value theory, stochastic processes, time series, and asymptotic statistics.

I recently submitted my doctoral dissertation and am looking for postdoctoral positions.

[Explore my research](research.qmd){.dissertation-btn .dissertation-btn-primary}
